==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a massive, futuristic, metal tower. It appears to be located in space. It is either in an asteroid, or on the moon.

Inside the tower there is a large database room. Floating, holographic, blue, display screens hover in the air. Here I have access to files on various alien phenomenon.

I discover files related to an app that can cross reference multiple declassified sources to answer questions concerning extraterrestrial life. Using the app I discover information concerning some kind of craft. The craft is identified as being of extraterrestrial origin with absolute certainty.
